label: Produced because of its end-content: favouring depends on realization of the end D
definition: BecauseOfContent fit φ s x y is DependsUnder fit (fun _ => ()) φ s x y: realization of D ranks x over y at s and the source favours x over y there, and in some scenario where the realization of the end D (fit) does not rank x over y, the source does not favour x over y either. A source tracking D passes; a fixed proxy favouring a physical type that coincides with D in the actual scenario fails it. A profile defined as tracking D passes by construction; what is substantive is the interpretive claim that a given source's favouring tracks D rather than the physical type.
note: Analyst reading BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_1: the good content D specifies the productive orientation (formal and final explanation under the orientation's proper end-description, will-versus-chance.md §C). It does not require that the goodness of D, as distinct from D's realization, makes a difference. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §§65–69.
